    config.combine_as_imports = True
    contents = "from os import path as p, name as n\nprint('hello')"
    result = file_contents(contents, config)
    assert isinstance(result, ParsedContent)
    assert result.lines_without_imports == ["print('hello')"]
    assert result.import_index == 0
    assert result.imports["STDLIB"]["from"]["os"] is True
    assert result.as_map["from"]["os.path"] == ["p"]
    assert result.as_map["from"]["os.name"] == ["n"]
    assert result.categorized_comments["from"]["os.__combined_as__"] == []
    assert result.change_count == -1
